strict_if: Any v3 prompt_json format failure; freeze prompt and repeat same focus cases twice with only output_mode changed
focus_gate: All candidate focus responses must preserve required claims and no IDs, unsupported doubts, or format errors. Compare baseline but do not exempt a known missing required field. Do not continue broad evaluation on semantic failure.
broad: existing dev12 both baseline and selected candidate once; remaining G01/G03/G05/G06/G07/G08/G10/G12 selected candidate twice; four expression variants candidate twice
broad_gate: No new missing required claims against baseline; all targeted display, grounding, conditions and conflict checks pass; no candidate JSON failures. G09 opinion-generation feature is excluded before execution, not dropped after seeing results.
review: Implementing AI nonblind semantic review; known synthetic/regression cases, not independent holdout
policy: No retries, same-prompt repeats predeclared, no output repair, no changing fixture or prompt after output inspection
